Title: Temporary control effects and ousted players

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body:
What happens in the following scenario...

Vampire x (who is a malkavian) controlled by player A is stolen by player B with Malkavian Dementia. Then before the effect of the dementia runs out, player A gets ousted. What happens to vamipre x when the effect of dementia runs out? Does it stay permanently under the control of player B since A is no longer there for it to return to, or does it get removed from the game for the same reason?

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Vampire x is removed from the game if his controller was ousted in the meantime.  [LSJ 20090316]

Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Correct: when the temporary change of control ends, the vampire is removed from the game if his controller was ousted in the meantime.

Messages.Author: Kude
Messages.Body: So how about temporary things like Seeds of Corruption. Do those leave the table if Meth who put them is ousted?

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body:
> Kude wrote:
> So how about temporary things like Seeds of Corruption. Do those leave the table if Meth who put them is ousted?
>
Depends on who controls them. Minion cards without explicit card text otherwise are controlled by whoevers minions they are on, so seeds would stay, master cards instead are controlled by whoever played them so society of leopold or fame would go away.
